title: fix(cli)!: secret rewrap --apply without --yes in a non-interactive shell exits 1
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoE1BtVwhUEVSGpakbjyuiCV)_

Fixes #36679
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under skills/** mentions `os secret rewrap` (grep `rewrap` over skills/: 0 hits); the CLI reference section `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os secret rewrap` was re-read and says nothing about the exit status of an unconfirmed run, so nothing it states is falsified

## 维护者速读

- 运维在脚本、CI 或定时任务里运行密钥重新封装命令并要求写入、但没加确认参数时，以前显示「已中止」并返回成功，现在返回失败并提示加确认参数；交互式回答「否」照旧返回成功。
- 为什么做：与数据库迁移命令和两个孤儿清理命令已定的规则对齐，避免脚本把什么都没重新封装的一次运行当成密钥轮换完成。
- 出错会怎样：只改未确认时的退出码与提示文字，读取、重新封装和写入的内容都不变；依赖旧退出码的脚本需加确认参数，出问题可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Breaking

**BREAKING** (an exit status narrows), shipped as `patch`: the change is not to the metadata protocol (`Metadata-protocol: none`), so the level axis grades `patch`, as the precedent #36676 did for the orphans commands.

- **FROM:** `os secret rewrap --apply` on a database with a version-1 `sys_secret` row to re-wrap, without `--yes`, stdin not a terminal, text face: nothing opened or written, `Aborted — no row was opened or written.`, exit `0`.
- **TO:** nothing opened or written, `Confirmation required. Re-run with --yes to re-wrap. No row was opened or written.`, exit `1`.
- **Unchanged:** answering `n` at the `[y/N]` prompt in a terminal still prints `Aborted — …` and exits `0`; `--json` without `--yes` already exited `1` with `confirmation_required`; `--yes` re-wraps as before; a dry run, or an `--apply` run with nothing to re-wrap, asks nothing and keeps the exit status it had (`0` when the run is not otherwise refused; a missing data key or an incomplete reference union still exits `1`).
- **The fix for a script:** pass `--yes` to re-wrap; drop `--apply` to get only the dry-run report.

ADR-0087 disposition: the changeset carries the marker `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; no metadata, stored shape or export moves. `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` at b15bd751 (the marker is unchanged at 00049e7b): `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition` (`[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]`).

## What changes

`os secret rewrap --apply`, run where stdin is not a terminal and without `--yes`, now prints a warning naming `--yes` and exits 1. The shape is the one `os db orphans` / `os secret orphans` took in #36676 (and the `os migrate` family's): inside the `!flags.yes` gate, after the `--json` face, a non-TTY branch warns and calls `this.exit(1)`. The `this.exit(1)` sits inside the `try` whose `catch` already rethrows the exit signal (`isExitSignal`) and whose `finally` shuts the stack down. Nothing about what rewrap opens, re-seals or writes changes.

The confirmation pin `packages/cli/test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` widens its population from "non-migrate commands declaring boolean `delete` and `yes`" to "non-migrate commands declaring a boolean `yes`", whatever mode flag it confirms. Today that is `db orphans`, `secret orphans` and `secret rewrap`. The walk that feeds it now descends the whole of `src/commands` minus `migrate/` (top-level commands such as `os deploy` and subcommands two levels down such as `os plugin trust revoke` included), as the migrate pin's walk does, and decides membership off the loaded class's flags only: no source-text prefilter, so a quoted `'yes'` key or a flag from a shared flag set counts. A census case holds the list of loaded modules equal to an independent recursive listing of the same tree, so a walk that stops descending fails on its own; a second names today's three members. The next command with a `--yes` outside `src/commands/migrate` fails the population case until it has a roster row. Per ruling record 6583487846 the row goes into the existing harness file, not a new one. The rewrap row runs the real reference union, planner, executor and local crypto provider (over `OS_SECRET_KEY`) on a fake engine holding one version-1 row its setting references; only the boot is replaced.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts` — the new non-TTY branch inside the `!flags.yes` gate.
2. `packages/cli/test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` — the recursive walk and its census, the widened population, the `one-shot-settings` mock now keeping the real `oneShotCrypto`, and the rewrap fixture.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` — expect 15 passed.

## Tests

Per roster member (3): text face non-TTY without `--yes` (exit 1, output names `--yes`, nothing written, no export, no prompt); `--json` face (exit 1, `confirmation_required`); control `--yes` (exit 0, one write, export written where the mode writes one); control terminal answered `n` (prompted, exit 0, nothing written). Plus three population cases: the walk census (loaded modules == a recursive listing of `src/commands` minus `migrate/`), population == roster, and today's census. 15 tests.

<details><summary>Premise probe on origin/main 3e8edf78 (before the fix)</summary>

A probe driving the real command (boot replaced only):

```
PROBE tty=false exit=0 writes=0 lines=["  ℹ Aborted — no row was opened or written."]
PROBE tty=true exit=0 writes=0 lines=["  ℹ Aborted — no row was opened or written."]
```
</details>

<details><summary>Pin run at 00049e7b</summary>

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  15 passed (15)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations at 00049e7b, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs and restored (blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

A1, the non-TTY `this.exit(1)` in rewrap.ts removed (blob 104d5a39 -> d90df941):
```
     × secret rewrap — text face: exit 1, names --yes
      Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)
```
A2, the walk stopped below one directory (pin blob 3f67d892 -> 033acfbf):
```
     × the walk loaded every command module outside migrate, at every depth
-   "plugin/trust/add.ts",
-   "plugin/trust/list.ts",
-   "plugin/trust/revoke.ts",
      Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)
```
A3, a quoted `'yes'` boolean planted on the top-level `os deploy` (blob 953b5a1d -> b97875fa):
```
     × is exactly the roster — a new member names how its gate is reached before it can pass
     × the census today: three commands outside migrate declare --yes
      Tests  2 failed | 13 passed (15)
```
A4, a `yes` boolean planted on `os plugin trust revoke`, two directories down (blob a13e4d32 -> 03dc13f5): the same two cases red, 2 failed | 13 passed (15).

Two earlier attempts (A1 at 824d7593, A2 at 00049e7b) were refused by the tool as no-ops because the replacement text contained the anchor; nothing ran on either, and each was redone with a disjoint replacement.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` § `os secret rewrap` documents `-y, --yes` as "skip the confirmation prompt" and says nothing about the unconfirmed exit status; left as is (outside the claimed surface, and nothing in it is now false). The follow-up for all three commands is reported to the seat on #36679.
- Review round 1 (L1 7228108944, contract review 7228083567 PASS): S1 is fixed by the recursive walk and its census (commits 47487d3a, 00049e7b); N1 by scoping the Unchanged clause here and in the changeset; N2 is left to the seat.

## Verification

Local runs are listed with their head in the os-dev report on #36679; CI's check-runs on this PR are the record for every family CI runs.
